consolidation.linkage: complete (every pair inside a group is itself above tau), not transitive closure
consolidation.model: claude-haiku-4-5 via the claude CLI (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on this machine)
consolidation.note: the CLI exposes no temperature flag; determinism rests on the merge cache

conventions.credited: the merged record is credited in full for the queried event (generous)
conventions.expected: 1/(1+a) over the a+1 events the record conflates (the reader who must pick one)
conventions.strict: the merged record earns nothing once a >= 1 (the binding is gone)

dataset.citation: Maharana, Lee, Tulyakov, Bansal, Barbieri, Fang. ACL 2024.

exclusions.empty_evidence: no annotated event to be the answer
exclusions.unresolved_evidence: an evidence dia_id with no matching turn (9 of 2815 refs)

dataset.name: LoCoMo-10
dataset.subset: ALL ten conversations, ALL usable annotated questions. No subsampling.

decision_rule.IMMUNE: at the primary cell, `credited`, `expected` and `strict` return the SAME value on at least 95 percent of queries, i.e. the winning record absorbed none of that query's own distractors (a = 0) or the query was lost outright; the lever then has almost nothing to act on
decision_rule.SIGN_FLIPS: at the primary cell, delta under `credited` and under `strict` have opposite signs
decision_rule.STRONG_FLIP: SIGN_FLIPS and both BCa intervals exclude zero, in opposite directions

mapping.correct_trace: the earliest evidence turn of the question
mapping.distractors: evidence turns of OTHER included questions, from the annotation only, never from similarity; scope `session` is primary, `conversation` is reported alongside it
mapping.episode: one dialogue turn, rendered as the benchmark's own evaluation renders it
mapping.store: one per conversation; a cross-conversation merge is a pooling artifact

pre_registration.question: On a public benchmark, does the reported SIGN of the consolidation delta depend on the convention for crediting a merged record that absorbed several events?

seeds.justification: the pass is deterministic given the embedder, complete linkage and a temperature-0 merge cache; determinism is asserted by re-running one conversation under a second seed rather than paid for on all ten

statistics.pairing: same clusters, same queries, eligibility pinned to the before store
statistics.query_level_bootstrap: FORBIDDEN; the design effect on this project's own data was 2.37

delta_vs_before.method: paired-cluster-bootstrap percentile (degenerate: every resample identical) B=10000
